# Correct Dock adoption's default tear-out window contract

## Context
The release's new dashboard-benefits post links the Dock adoption path. On `dev@89f0cf6447`, the “tear-out window's render target” section still tells applications to provide platform vessel open/close, although the engine already provides both defaults.

## The Problem
An adopter is directed to write hooks the base class owns, and the section points to a `?popout` example boot without explaining that the base opener uses `?tearout=<itemId>`. Copying the example's route unchanged does not describe the default opener's target contract.

## The Architectural Reality
- `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsAdoption.md:421-441` describes the older application-owned open/close boundary.
- `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:1092-1184` provides the shared-worker same-document opener and shared close path; custom host overrides remain authoritative.
- `Workspace.mjs:363-369` keeps `enableDockTearOutLifecycle` opt-in.
- `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/Viewport.mjs:42-56` demonstrates an empty target, but recognizes its own `popout` / `workspaceId` routes.

Design authority: the owning opener JSDoc says, “Opens the tear-out vessel, defaulting to the host's own document.” This corrects documentation to the shipped implementation, not runtime behavior.

## The Fix
Rewrite the existing section to distinguish the engine defaults from application overrides. Explain the default URL's content selector, the separate topology identity carrier, and the application's empty target boot responsibility. Keep Workstation as the richer custom-host reference and describe the cross-window demo as a pattern with its own route contract.

| Target surface | Source of authority | Behavior described | Boundary | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Adoption guide: vessel hooks | Workspace open/close implementations | Base defaults work without custom open/close overrides | Dedicated routing, embodiment or theming may override | Compare revised prose with current source |
| Adoption guide: empty target | Default opener and demo Viewport | Match target boot to the opener's content route | Demo `popout` is not the default `tearout` route | Verify both route readers |

Decision Record impact: none. Structure map: N/A, existing Engine guide only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The guide accurately distinguishes lifecycle opt-in, shared-worker capability, default open/close and optional overrides.
- [ ] It names the empty target responsibility and explains the default `tearout` versus example `popout` route boundary.
- [ ] Stable source links resolve; guide lint and Markdown/portal rendering checks pass; no generated SEO surface changes.

## Out of Scope
Engine behavior, a new popup host, blog/notes authorship, and the multi-window tutorial series.

## Avoided Traps
Do not suggest that panes/zones alone create a complete multi-window application. Do not copy a demonstration host wholesale or repeat its routing as the engine default. Do not change a working engine API to preserve stale prose.
